remarks: Privately nestled in Red Coat, this distinctive classically designed Colonial offers just over 7,000 sq. ft. of above-grade living space, with 6 bedrooms, 5 full and 2 half baths, and an attached 3-car garage. Set on 1.59 beautifully landscaped acres, this home pairs timeless architecture with sophisticated finishes, and an effortless flow designed for entertaining, working, and everyday living. The welcoming front entrance is framed by a spacious covered porch. Inside, the gracious foyer features herringbone hardwood floors and detailed wainscoting, setting an elegant tone throughout. The living room features a fireplace and double French doors opening to the expansive patio. Two archways lead to a versatile bonus room with a dry bar, an ideal setting for a pool table or casual gathering space. The formal dining room, accessed through French doors from the foyer, features built-in hutch cabinetry. It connects seamlessly to the kitchen, which is exceptionally equipped with custom cabinetry and hutches, two sinks, center island, a separate pantry, and Wolf appliances. The kitchen opens to the expansive family room, where 3 sets of French doors bring in abundant natural light and lead to the rear patio and built-in grill. A convenient mudroom with a private half bath connects the main living spaces to the attached three-car garage, with access to the au pair quarters above.
